# files.FileUploadRequest

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `files.FileUploadRequest` |
| Kind | `command` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.file.upload` |
